## `PocketIDUser.spec`

<sup>[↩ PocketIDUser](#pocketiduser)</sup>

PocketIDUserSpec defines the desired state of PocketIDUser

**Validation rules:**

- userID is immutable

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `userID` | string |  |  | UserID is the optional user ID to use instead of one generated by Pocket-ID.<br />Pocket-ID only accepts a lowercase UUID here, and the ID is immutable once the<br />user is created.<br />_Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]\{8\}-[0-9a-f]\{4\}-[0-9a-f]\{4\}-[0-9a-f]\{4\}-[0-9a-f]\{12\}$`_ |
| [`username`](#pocketiduserspecusername) | object |  |  | Username of the user. Defaults to the metadata.name<br />Can be a plain value or reference a secret |
| [`firstName`](#pocketiduserspecfirstname) | object |  |  | First name of the user<br />Can be a plain value or reference a secret<br />Defaults to metadata.name of the Resource |
| [`lastName`](#pocketiduserspeclastname) | object |  |  | Last name of the user<br />Can be a plain value or reference a secret |
| [`email`](#pocketiduserspecemail) | object |  |  | Email of the user<br />Can be a plain value or reference a secret<br />Required unless email is disabled in pocket-id |
| [`displayName`](#pocketiduserspecdisplayname) | object |  |  | DisplayName of the user<br />Defaults to "spec.FirstName spec.LastName" |
| `instanceSelector` | [LabelSelector](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.37/#labelselector-v1-meta) |  |  | InstanceSelector selects the PocketIDInstance to reconcile against.<br />If omitted, the controller expects exactly one instance in the cluster. |
| `userInfoSecretRef` | [LocalObjectReference](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.37/#localobjectreference-v1-core) |  |  | UserInfoSecretRef references a single Secret containing sensitive user profile fields.<br />Values from the secret are evaluated last, so spec.username will override the username key in this secret<br />Keys: username, firstName, lastName, email, displayName |
| `admin` | boolean |  | `false` | Flag whether a user is an admin or not |
| `disabled` | boolean |  | `false` | Disabled indicates whether the user account is disabled |
| `locale` | string |  |  | Locale is the user's preferred locale (e.g., "en", "de", "fr") |
| [`apiKeys`](#pocketiduserspecapikeys) | []object |  |  | APIKeys is a list of API keys to create for this user |
| [`customClaims`](#pocketiduserspeccustomclaims) | []object |  |  | CustomClaims are additional claims to attach to this user.<br />User claims take precedence over claims inherited from the user's groups. |
